# DESIGN:OS Studio (design-os-studio)

> FREE, local-first Rust studio that opens and writes `.fig` files with no Figma app installed. Writing a .fig has known issue [#834](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-studio/issues/834) (numbered lists; variable-bound paints on instances written as fixed values). Current release: v0.7.13. Agents edit a `.fig` headless through `designos-mcp` (39 tools) or the `designos` CLI (`--inspect-json`, `--export-fig`, `--scan-design-system`, `--codegen`). Source-available under PolyForm Shield 1.0.0.

Native GPU-accelerated interface design studio (`wgpu` with a `tiny-skia` CPU renderer; Metal is verified on macOS, Direct3D 12 and Vulkan on Windows and Linux are not verified before release). Reads and writes `.fig` container version 106. Native Agentic PTY Chat UI (`Claude Code` · `Codex` · `Antigravity CLI` · `Grok CLI` · `Gemini CLI`). Live Variables Mode Switching & Multi-Edit (`Q`). Multi-target Dev Mode code generator (CSS, Tailwind, React, SwiftUI, UIKit, Jetpack Compose, Android XML, HTML). `designos-mcp` is a local stdio server and does not attach to the desktop editor.

## Key Facts & Verification Metrics

- [Overview & Live Visual Proof Gallery](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-studio/): Live documentation and visual proof for DESIGN:OS Studio
- [Repository](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-studio): Source repository on GitHub
- [Canonical Agent Skill](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-studio/blob/main/skills/design-os-studio/SKILL.md): Agent skill entry point (`skills/design-os-studio/SKILL.md`)
- [Diagnostics](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-studio/blob/main/commands/doctor.md): `python3 scripts/self_check.py` and `/doctor`
- [Quality gates](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-studio/blob/main/scripts/zero_fake_ui_gate.py): `14 / 14` Zero-Fake-UI invariants (`python3 scripts/zero_fake_ui_gate.py`) and more than `2,800` automated tests (`cargo test --workspace`, passing in macOS CI)
- [CHANGELOG 0.7.13](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-studio/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): v0.7.13 finishes the basics of auto layout and components for imported Figma files. Re-solving every auto-layout frame of the imported Untitled UI PRO v8.0 kit moved 61,948 of 194,397 layers by more than 0.5 px before this release and moves 2,039 now. A nested instance whose variant is bound to a variable follows the mode where it sits. A `.fig` save keeps the overrides of an instance on a page that was never opened after its main component is edited.
- [Enterprise Scale benchmark (customer benchmark file)](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-studio/blob/main/AGENTS.md?plain=1#L55): A customer's benchmark `.fig` file with `112,474` scene nodes (`723,136` Kiwi records). The GPU canvas culls with a uniform spatial grid and zoom-based level of detail, and re-blits the cached frame without requesting repaints while the view is idle
- [Release packages](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-studio/releases): macOS `.dmg` + `.tar.gz` (Apple Silicon and Intel, verified), Windows `.zip` with `install.ps1`, Linux `.deb` + `.tar.gz` (x64). The Windows and Linux packages are built by the same release workflow but are not verified before release. Every package bundles all 4 binaries (`designos-studio`, `designos`, `designos-mcp`, `designos-diff`)
- [Privacy](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-studio/blob/main/PRIVACY.md): Zero telemetry. The Studio uses the network only to download missing fonts, import from the Figma REST API with your own token, and install plugins
- [License](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-studio/blob/main/LICENSE): Source-available under PolyForm Shield 1.0.0; free to use and modify; no resale or competing products

## DESIGN:OS Ecosystem

- [DESIGN:OS Studio](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-studio/): Native Rust/wgpu interface design studio & Figma `.fig` v106 engine.
- [DESIGN:OS CLI](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os/): Multi-runtime design CLI for Claude Code, Codex & Antigravity.
- [Knowledge Builder](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-knowledge-builder/): Multimodal knowledge pipeline, auto-research loop and epistemic stopping gate for AI coding agents.
- [Figma Plugin & CLI](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-figma-plugin/): Live canvas bridge for AI coding agents on Figma Free.
- [SVG Animation Engine](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-svg-animation/): Deterministic vector animation & 1080p 60fps video pipeline.
- [3D Blender Agent](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-3d-blender/): Mechanical parts generation with embedded Three.js CAD viewer.
- [OPAH ONE](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-drone-showcase/): Scroll-scrub product page built end to end with DESIGN:OS (343 WebP frames, exploded-view tour, DTCG-compiled tokens). Fictional product.
- [GitHub Pages Engine](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-github-page/): Author-grade GitHub Pages marketing and docs engine for builders and AI coding agents.
- [Apple Design OS](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-apple/): SwiftUI design-system library for iOS, iPadOS & macOS.
- [Agent Teacher](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-pedagogy/): Evidence-graded pedagogy library and curriculum tree runtime.
- [Origami CAD](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-origami/): Parametric packaging dielines, spot-color PDFs & 3D fold previews.
- [Voice UX](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-voice-ux/): Voice and conversational AI knowledge base with state machines, latency budgets and usability protocols.
- [Code2Flow](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-code2flow/): Turns a Next.js codebase into a living user-flow canvas with real screenshots, lint and diff. 100% local.
- [Generative UI](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-generative-ui/): Streaming interactive visual runtime with morphdom & WebGL.
